of essential services, including TSOs and
DSOs.
• Risk management measures
• Incident notification (24h / 72h)
• Supply-chain security
• Board-level accountability
Imposes a DEFENSIVE POSTURE -- requires
operators to identify threats, assess risk,
and implement proportionate controls.

div.div:
Export and intra-Union transfer controls
on dual-use items.
• Public-domain carve-out for openly
published software and data
• Deployment-level classification for
operator-confidential data
• Architectural separation: open
orchestration / controlled data layer
The CARVE-OUT enables the platform's
codebase to circulate freely while
national deployments remain classified.
